title: D&D Icons of the Realms: Guildmasters' Guide to Ravnica

paragraphs.text: D&D Icons of the Realms is an on-going line of pre-painted miniatures produced by WizKids , created as a supplement for the Dungeons & Dragons tabletop roleplaying game. When Magic: The Gathering and D&D made their first official crossover with the D&D Guildmasters' Guide to Ravnica , Wizkids joined in with series of miniatures especially created for the setting of Ravnica . It was released in November 28, 2018.

D&D Icons of the Realms: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica features characters and creatures chronicled in the D&D supplement book. In all, the set includes a total of 55 figures, including the Deathpact Angel , the Gruul Anarch, the Boros Reckoner , and the Nightveil Specter , as well as the guildmasters of Ravnica themselves (including the mysterious Lazav and benevolent Trostani ).

The D&D Icons of the Realms: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica Companion Starter Set One and Starter Set Two each contain five heroes for your adventures (each representing one of the ten Ravnican Guilds). MSRP: $24.99

Additional figures are available in randomly-packed blind Standard Boosters . Each booster comes with four figures, including one large figure and three medium or small figures. Standard Boosters are sold in an eight-count Booster Brick with an MSRP of $127.92 per Booster Brick, or $15.99 per Standard Booster.

Customers who pre-order a full case of Booster Bricks (4 bricks or 32 Standard Boosters) are eligible to purchase one case incentive figure depicting the Izzet Guildmaster Niv-Mizzet . The larger-size Niv-Mizzet Red Dragon Premium Figure has an MSRP of $49.99, and is available only while supplies last.
